```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import {
  BarChart3,
  DollarSign,
  PieChart,
  TrendingUp,
  Users,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Target,
} from "lucide-react";

interface PortfolioMetrics {
  totalProjects: number;
  activeProjects: number;
  completedProjects: number;
  totalBudget: number;
  spentBudget: number;
  totalResources: number;
  allocatedResources: number;
  riskProjects: number;
  onTimeProjects: number;
}

const mockMetrics: PortfolioMetrics = {
  totalProjects: 24,
  activeProjects: 18,
  completedProjects: 6,
  totalBudget: 2500000,
  spentBudget: 1850000,
  totalResources: 156,
  allocatedResources: 142,
  riskProjects: 3,
  onTimeProjects: 15,
};

export default function ProjectPortfolioDashboardPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const budgetPercentage = (mockMetrics.spentBudget / mockMetrics.totalBudget) * 100;
  const resourceUtilization = (mockMetrics.allocatedResources / mockMetrics.totalResources) * 100;
  const completionRate = (mockMetrics.completedProjects / mockMetrics.totalProjects) * 100;
  const onTimeRate = (mockMetrics.onTimeProjects / mockMetrics.activeProjects) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <BarChart3 className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.title", "Dashboard de Portfolio de Proyectos")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">
            {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.description", "Vista general del portfolio de proyectos")}
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.totalProjects", "Total Proyectos")}
              </CardTitle>
              <Target className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockMetrics.totalProjects}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {mockMetrics.activeProjects} {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.active", "activos")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.budget", "Presupuesto")}
              </CardTitle>
              <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                ${(mockMetrics.spentBudget / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {budgetPercentage.toFixed(1)}% {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.used", "utilizado")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.resources", "Recursos")}
              </CardTitle>
              <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockMetrics.allocatedResources}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {resourceUtilization.toFixed(1)}% {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.utilization", "utilización")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.completion", "Completados")}
              </CardTitle>
              <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockMetrics.completedProjects}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {completionRate.toFixed(1)}% {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.rate", "tasa")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <PieChart className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.budgetBreakdown", "Desglose de Presupuesto")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span>{t("projects.portfolioDashboard.spent", "Gastado")}</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">${(mockMetrics.spentBudget / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                  <div
                    className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${budgetPercentage}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                  <span>{t("projects.portfolioDashboard.remaining", "Restante")}</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">
                    ${((mockMetrics.totalBudget - mockMetrics.spentBudget) / 1000).toLocaleString()}K
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                  <div
                    className="bg-green-500 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${100 - budgetPercentage}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("projects.portfolioDashboard.projectStatus", "Estado de Proyectos")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-green-500" />
                  <span>{t("projects.portfolioDashboard.onTime", "A Tiempo")}</span>
                </div>
                <span className="font-bold">{mockMetrics.onTimeProjects}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500" />
                  <span>{t("projects.portfolioDashboard.inProgress", "En Progreso")}</span>
                </div>
                <span className="font-bold">{mockMetrics.activeProjects - mockMetrics.onTimeProjects}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                  <span>{t("projects.portfolioDashboard.atRisk", "En Riesgo")}</span>
                </div>
                <span className="font-bold">{mockMetrics.riskProjects}</span>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import {
  FolderKanban,
  Plus,
  Search,
  Filter,
  ArrowRight,
  Calendar,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface Project {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: "active" | "completed" | "on-hold" | "cancelled";
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  budget: number;
  spent: number;
  teamSize: number;
  progress: number;
}

const mockProjects: Project[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    name: "Proyecto Alpha",
    description: "Sistema de gestión empresarial",
    status: "active",
    startDate: "2024-01-15",
    endDate: "2024-12-31",
    budget: 500000,
    spent: 325000,
    teamSize: 12,
    progress: 65,
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    name: "Proyecto Beta",
    description: "Plataforma de e-commerce",
    status: "active",
    startDate: "2024-03-01",
    endDate: "2025-02-28",
    budget: 750000,
    spent: 180000,
    teamSize: 18,
    progress: 24,
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    name: "Proyecto Gamma",
    description: "Aplicación móvil",
    status: "completed",
    startDate: "2023-06-01",
    endDate: "2024-05-31",
    budget: 300000,
    spent: 285000,
    teamSize: 8,
    progress: 100,
  },
];

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "active":
      return "default";
    case "completed":
      return "secondary";
    case "on-hold":
      return "outline";
    case "cancelled":
      return "destructive";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectsOverviewPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <FolderKanban className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.overview.title", "Proyectos")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("projects.overview.newProject", "Nuevo Proyecto")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={t("projects.overview.search", "Buscar proyectos...")}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.filter", "Filtrar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {mockProjects.map((project) => (
            <Card
              key={project.id}
              className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300"
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg mb-2">{project.name}</CardTitle>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{project.description}</p>
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant={getStatusColor(project.status) as any}>
                    {t(`projects.status.${project.status}`, project.status)}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("projects.overview.progress", "Progreso")}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">{project.progress}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${project.progress}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <span>{project.teamSize} {t("projects.overview.members", "miembros")}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <span>${(project.spent / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Link href={`/projects/${project.id}`}>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    {t("common.details", "Detalles")}
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  Edit,
  Calendar,
  Users,
  DollarSign,
  FileText,
  Settings,
  TrendingUp,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";

interface ProjectDetail {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  status: "active" | "completed" | "on-hold" | "cancelled";
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  budget: number;
  spent: number;
  teamSize: number;
  progress: number;
  domain?: string;
  owner?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

const mockProject: ProjectDetail = {
  id: 1,
  name: "Proyecto Alpha",
  description: "Sistema de gestión empresarial completo con módulos de contabilidad, recursos humanos y CRM.",
  status: "active",
  startDate: "2024-01-15",
  endDate: "2024-12-31",
  budget: 500000,
  spent: 325000,
  teamSize: 12,
  progress: 65,
  domain: "Gestión Empresarial",
  owner: "Juan Pérez",
  createdAt: "2024-01-10T00:00:00Z",
  updatedAt: "2024-11-15T10:30:00Z",
};

export default function ProjectDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const id = searchParams.get("id") || "1";
  const project = mockProject;

  const budgetPercentage = (project.spent / project.budget) * 100;
  const daysRemaining = Math.ceil(
    (new Date(project.endDate).getTime() - new Date().getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
  );

  const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "active":
        return "default";
      case "completed":
        return "secondary";
      case "on-hold":
        return "outline";
      case "cancelled":
        return "destructive";
      default:
        return "outline";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link href="/projects/list">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon">
                <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent flex items-center gap-3">
                {project.name}
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">{project.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Badge variant={getStatusColor(project.status) as any}>
              {t(`projects.status.${project.status}`, project.status)}
            </Badge>
            <Button>
              <Edit className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {t("common.edit", "Editar")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("projects.detail.information", "Información General")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.detail.domain", "Dominio")}
                    </label>
                    <p className="text-foreground font-medium">{project.domain || "-"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.detail.owner", "Propietario")}
                    </label>
                    <p className="text-foreground font-medium">{project.owner || "-"}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.detail.startDate", "Fecha de Inicio")}
                    </label>
                    <p className="text-foreground font-medium">
                      {new Date(project.startDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.detail.endDate", "Fecha de Fin")}
                    </label>
                    <p className="text-foreground font-medium">
                      {new Date(project.endDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("projects.detail.progress", "Progreso")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("projects.detail.completion", "Completado")}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">{project.progress}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-3">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-3 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${project.progress}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {daysRemaining > 0
                    ? t("projects.detail.daysRemaining", `${daysRemaining} días restantes`)
                    : t("projects.detail.overdue", "Proyecto vencido")}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-6">
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("projects.detail.budget", "Presupuesto")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.detail.total", "Total")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">${(project.budget / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.detail.spent", "Gastado")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">${(project.spent / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.detail.remaining", "Restante")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-bold">
                    ${((project.budget - project.spent) / 1000).toLocaleString()}K
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2 mt-2">
                  <div
                    className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${budgetPercentage}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">

                  </label>
                  <p className="text-sm text-foreground">
                    {new Date(project.createdAt).toLocaleString()}

                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.detail.updatedAt", "Actualizado")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-sm text-foreground">
                    {new Date(project.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Dashboard",
    "code-playground": "Code Playground",
    playground: "AI Playground",
    "model-management": "Model Management",
    serving: "Serving",
    "technology-management": "Technology Management",
    "domain-ingestion": "Domain Ingestion",
    "data-sources": "Fuentes de Información",
    admin: "Admin",
    team: "Admin",
    config: "Admin",
    "training-center": "Training Center",
    plugins: "Plugins",
    projects: "Projects",
    rag: "RAG System",
    "model-evaluation": "Model Evaluation",
    training: "AI Training",
    governance: "Governance",
    bpmn: "BPMN",
    analytics: "Analytics",
    // NUEVAS RUTAS DEL CORE
    departments: "Departments",
    sessions: "User Sessions",
    audit: "Audit System",
    licenses: "Platform Licenses",
    nodes: "Platform Nodes",
    updates: "Platform Updates",
    // INFRASTRUCTURE
    infrastructure: "Infrastructure",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Dashboard";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}

interface ProjectRequirement {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  projectName: string;
  priority: "high" | "medium" | "low";
  status: "open" | "in-progress" | "completed" | "cancelled";
  assignedTo: string;
}

const mockRequirements: ProjectRequirement[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    title: "Sistema de Autenticación",

    priority: "high",
    status: "in-progress",

  {

  {

    priority: "low",
    status: "completed",
    assignedTo: "Carlos López",
  },
];

const getPriorityColor = (priority: string) => {
  switch (priority) {
    case "high":
      return "destructive";
    case "medium":
      return "default";
    case "low":
      return "secondary";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

const getStatusIcon = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {

};

        <div className="flex gap-4">

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { TrendingUp, DollarSign, PieChart, BarChart3, ArrowUp, ArrowDown } from "lucide-react";

interface FinancialSummary {
  totalBudget: number;
  totalSpent: number;
  totalRemaining: number;
  projectsCount: number;
  averageBudget: number;
  budgetUtilization: number;
  monthlySpending: Array<{ month: string; amount: number }>;
  categoryBreakdown: Array<{ category: string; amount: number; percentage: number }>;
}

const mockFinancialSummary: FinancialSummary = {
  totalBudget: 2500000,
  totalSpent: 1850000,
  totalRemaining: 650000,
  projectsCount: 24,
  averageBudget: 104167,
  budgetUtilization: 74,
  monthlySpending: [
    { month: "Ene", amount: 150000 },
    { month: "Feb", amount: 180000 },
    { month: "Mar", amount: 200000 },
    { month: "Abr", amount: 190000 },
    { month: "May", amount: 210000 },
    { month: "Jun", amount: 220000 },
  ],
  categoryBreakdown: [
    { category: "Desarrollo", amount: 900000, percentage: 48.6 },
    { category: "Infraestructura", amount: 500000, percentage: 27.0 },
    { category: "Recursos Humanos", amount: 300000, percentage: 16.2 },
    { category: "Otros", amount: 150000, percentage: 8.1 },
  ],
};

export default function ProjectFinancialSummaryPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const maxSpending = Math.max(...mockFinancialSummary.monthlySpending.map((m) => m.amount));

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <TrendingUp className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.financialSummary.title", "Resumen Financiero de Proyectos")}
            </h1>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.financialSummary.totalBudget", "Presupuesto Total")}
              </CardTitle>
              <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">${(mockFinancialSummary.totalBudget / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {mockFinancialSummary.projectsCount} {t("projects.financialSummary.projects", "proyectos")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.financialSummary.totalSpent", "Total Gastado")}
              </CardTitle>
              <ArrowDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">${(mockFinancialSummary.totalSpent / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {mockFinancialSummary.budgetUtilization}% {t("projects.financialSummary.utilized", "utilizado")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.financialSummary.totalRemaining", "Total Restante")}
              </CardTitle>
              <ArrowUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">${(mockFinancialSummary.totalRemaining / 1000000).toFixed(2)}M</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {100 - mockFinancialSummary.budgetUtilization}% {t("projects.financialSummary.available", "disponible")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.financialSummary.averageBudget", "Presupuesto Promedio")}
              </CardTitle>
              <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">${(mockFinancialSummary.averageBudget / 1000).toFixed(0)}K</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {t("projects.financialSummary.perProject", "por proyecto")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <BarChart3 className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("projects.financialSummary.monthlySpending", "Gastos Mensuales")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              {mockFinancialSummary.monthlySpending.map((month, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{month.month}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">${(month.amount / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${(month.amount / maxSpending) * 100}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <PieChart className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                {t("projects.financialSummary.categoryBreakdown", "Desglose por Categoría")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              {mockFinancialSummary.categoryBreakdown.map((category, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{category.category}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">
                      ${(category.amount / 1000).toLocaleString()}K ({category.percentage.toFixed(1)}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${category.percentage}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

}

// Función para obtener módulos por roles
export const getModulesByRoles = (roles: string[]): ModuleConfig[] => {
  return modulesConfig.filter((module) =>
    module.roles.some((role) => roles.includes(role))
  );
};

// Función para obtener módulo por ruta
export const getModuleByPath = (pathname: string): string => {
  const path = pathname.split("/")[1];

  const moduleMap: Record<string, string> = {
    dashboard: "Dashboard",
    "code-playground": "Code Playground",
    playground: "AI Playground",
    "model-management": "Model Management",
    serving: "Serving",
    "technology-management": "Technology Management",
    "domain-ingestion": "Domain Ingestion",
    "data-sources": "Fuentes de Información",
    admin: "Admin",
    team: "Admin",
    config: "Admin",
    "training-center": "Training Center",
    plugins: "Plugins",
    projects: "Projects",
    rag: "RAG System",
    "model-evaluation": "Model Evaluation",
    training: "AI Training",
    governance: "Governance",
    bpmn: "BPMN",
    analytics: "Analytics",
    // NUEVAS RUTAS DEL CORE
    departments: "Departments",
    sessions: "User Sessions",
    audit: "Audit System",
    licenses: "Platform Licenses",
    nodes: "Platform Nodes",
    updates: "Platform Updates",
    // INFRASTRUCTURE
    infrastructure: "Infrastructure",
  };

  return moduleMap[path] || "Dashboard";
};

// Función para validar si un usuario puede acceder a un módulo
export const canAccessModule = (
  userRoles: string[],
  moduleName: string
): boolean => {
  const module = modulesConfig.find((m) => m.name === moduleName);
  return module ? module.roles.some((role) => userRoles.includes(role)) : false;
};

Te permiten crear chatbots y asistentes que pueden responder preguntas basándose en tus propios documentos y datos.</p><h4>¿Para qué sirven?</h4><ul><li><strong>Chatbots Especializados:</strong> Crea asistentes que conocen tu documentación específica</li><li><strong>Búsqueda Inteligente:</strong> Encuentra información relevante en grandes volúmenes de documentos</li><li><strong>Respuestas Contextualizadas:</strong> Genera respuestas precisas basadas en tu contenido</li><li><strong>Automatización de Soporte:</strong> Reduce la carga de trabajo del equipo de soporte</li><li><strong>Base de Conocimiento Interactiva:</strong> Convierte documentos estáticos en una experiencia conversacional</li></ul><h4>Gestión de Proyectos</h4><p>Desde esta página puedes:</p><ul><li>Crear nuevos proyectos RAG con configuraciones personalizadas</li><li>Editar modelos de IA (embedding, reranker, LLM) para cada proyecto</li><li>Monitorear el rendimiento y estadísticas de uso</li><li>Gestionar las fuentes de datos asignadas a cada proyecto</li><li>Configurar parámetros de chunking y procesamiento</li></ul>",
        },
        createProject: {
          title: "Crear Proyecto RAG",
          content:
            "Crea un nuevo proyecto RAG configurando los modelos de embedding, reranker y LLM, así como los parámetros de chunking y configuración del servidor Leka.",
        },
        editProject: {
          title: "Editar Proyecto RAG",
          content:

        models: {
          title: "Modelos RAG",

        createModel: {
          title: "Crear Modelo RAG",
          content:
            "<h4>Configuración de Modelos de IA</h4><p>Esta página te permite crear y configurar nuevos modelos de IA para tus proyectos RAG. Puedes configurar:</p><ul><li><strong>Información Básica:</strong> Nombre, tipo (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), proveedor y versión</li><li><strong>Configuración Técnica:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, costo por token, máximo de tokens y ventana de contexto</li><li><strong>Opciones Avanzadas:</strong> Modelo local vs remoto, estado activo/inactivo</li></ul><p><strong>Tipos de Modelos:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Convierte texto en vectores numéricos para búsqueda semántica</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Mejora la relevancia de los resultados de búsqueda</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Genera respuestas basadas en el contexto recuperado</li></ul><p>Una vez configurado, puedes probar el modelo antes de guardarlo para asegurar que funciona correctamente.</p>",

        projects: {
          title: "RAG Projects",
          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",

          title: "Edit RAG Project",
          content:

        createModel: {
          title: "Create RAG Model",
          content:
            "<h4>AI Model Configuration</h4><p>This page allows you to create and configure new AI models for your RAG projects. You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}

            "<h4>¿Qué son los Proyectos RAG?</h4><p>Los proyectos RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) son sistemas inteligentes que combinan la recuperación de información con la generación de texto.         projects: {
          title: "RAG Projects",
          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",

          content:
            "<h4>AI Model Configuration</h4><p>This page allows you to create and configure new AI models for your RAG projects. You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}

                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

          </Card>

      </div>

  allocatedResources: number;
  availableResources: number;
  utilizationRate: number;
  byProject: Array<{ projectName: string; allocated: number; percentage: number }>;
  byRole: Array<{ role: string; count: number; percentage: number }>;
}

const mockResourceAllocation: ResourceAllocation = {
  totalResources: 156,
  allocatedResources: 142,
  availableResources: 14,
  utilizationRate: 91,
  byProject: [
    { projectName: "Proyecto Alpha", allocated: 25, percentage: 17.6 },
    { projectName: "Proyecto Beta", allocated: 30, percentage: 21.1 },
    { projectName: "Proyecto Gamma", allocated: 20, percentage: 14.1 },
    { projectName: "Proyecto Delta", allocated: 15, percentage: 10.6 },
    { projectName: "Otros", allocated: 52, percentage: 36.6 },
  ],
  byRole: [
    { role: "Developer", count: 65, percentage: 45.8 },
    { role: "Project Manager", count: 25, percentage: 17.6 },
    { role: "Architect", count: 20, percentage: 14.1 },
    { role: "QA", count: 18, percentage: 12.7 },
    { role: "DevOps", count: 14, percentage: 9.9 },
  ],
};

        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />

        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.resourceAllocation.title", "Asignación de Recursos")}
            </h1>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.resourceAllocation.totalResources", "Total Recursos")}
              </CardTitle>
              <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockResourceAllocation.totalResources}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {t("projects.resourceAllocation.resources", "recursos")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.resourceAllocation.allocated", "Asignados")}
              </CardTitle>
              <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockResourceAllocation.allocatedResources}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {mockResourceAllocation.utilizationRate}% {t("projects.resourceAllocation.utilization", "utilización")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.resourceAllocation.available", "Disponibles")}

              <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockResourceAllocation.availableResources}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {100 - mockResourceAllocation.utilizationRate}% {t("projects.resourceAllocation.free", "libres")}

            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">

                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">

                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"

              ))}

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">

              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-4">
              {mockResourceAllocation.byRole.map((role) => (
                <div key={role.role} className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">{role.role}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">
                      {role.count} ({role.percentage.toFixed(1)}%)
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${role.percentage}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

                    <span className="font-medium">

        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TrendingDown className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              {t("projects.costBreakdown.monthlyTrend", "Tendencia Mensual")}

                  <span className="font-medium">${(month.amount / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">

                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { AlertTriangle, TrendingUp, Shield, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";

interface RiskAssessment {
  totalRisks: number;
  highRisks: number;
  mediumRisks: number;
  lowRisks: number;
  risks: Array<{
    id: number;
    projectName: string;
    riskType: string;
    severity: "high" | "medium" | "low";
    description: string;
    mitigation: string;
    status: "open" | "mitigated" | "closed";
  }>;
}

const mockRiskAssessment: RiskAssessment = {
  totalRisks: 12,
  highRisks: 3,
  mediumRisks: 5,
  lowRisks: 4,
  risks: [
    {
      id: 1,
      projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
      riskType: "Técnico",
      severity: "high",
      description: "Posible retraso en la integración de APIs externas",
      mitigation: "Asignar recursos adicionales y establecer buffer de tiempo",
      status: "open",
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      projectName: "Proyecto Beta",
      riskType: "Presupuesto",
      severity: "medium",
      description: "Riesgo de sobrecostos en infraestructura",
      mitigation: "Revisar y optimizar uso de recursos cloud",
      status: "open",
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      projectName: "Proyecto Gamma",
      riskType: "Recursos",
      severity: "low",
      description: "Posible rotación de personal clave",
      mitigation: "Documentar conocimiento crítico y cross-training",
      status: "mitigated",
    },
  ],
};

const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
  switch (severity) {
    case "high":
      return "destructive";
    case "medium":
      return "default";
    case "low":
      return "secondary";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectRiskAssessmentPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.riskAssessment.title", "Evaluación de Riesgos")}
            </h1>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.riskAssessment.totalRisks", "Total Riesgos")}
              </CardTitle>
              <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{mockRiskAssessment.totalRisks}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-red-500/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.riskAssessment.highRisks", "Riesgos Altos")}
              </CardTitle>
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-500">{mockRiskAssessment.highRisks}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-yellow-500/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.riskAssessment.mediumRisks", "Riesgos Medios")}
              </CardTitle>
              <Shield className="h-4 w-4 text-yellow-500" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-500">{mockRiskAssessment.mediumRisks}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-green-500/50 transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between space-y-0 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.riskAssessment.lowRisks", "Riesgos Bajos")}
              </CardTitle>
              <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-500">{mockRiskAssessment.lowRisks}</div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {mockRiskAssessment.risks.map((risk) => (
            <Card
              key={risk.id}
              className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300"
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg mb-2">{risk.projectName}</CardTitle>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                      <Badge variant={getSeverityColor(risk.severity) as any}>
                        {t(`projects.riskAssessment.severity.${risk.severity}`, risk.severity)}
                      </Badge>
                      <Badge variant="outline">{risk.riskType}</Badge>
                      <Badge variant={risk.status === "closed" ? "secondary" : "default"}>
                        {t(`projects.riskAssessment.status.${risk.status}`, risk.status)}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.riskAssessment.description", "Descripción")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-foreground">{risk.description}</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.riskAssessment.mitigation", "Mitigación")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-foreground">{risk.mitigation}</p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

              {t("projects.roiAnalysis.timeline", "Evolución Temporal")}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            {mockROIAnalysis.timeline.map((period) => (
              <div key={period.period} className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">{period.period}</span>
                  <span className="font-medium">{period.roi.toFixed(1)}% ROI</span>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                  <div
                    className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${(period.roi / 30) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { Clock, Plus, Search, Filter, ArrowRight, User, Calendar } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface TimeTracking {
  id: number;
  projectName: string;
  memberName: string;
  task: string;
  hours: number;
  date: string;
  status: "approved" | "pending" | "rejected";
}

const mockTimeTracking: TimeTracking[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
    memberName: "María García",
    task: "Desarrollo de API REST",
    hours: 8,
    date: "2024-11-15",
    status: "approved",
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    projectName: "Proyecto Beta",
    memberName: "Juan Pérez",
    task: "Diseño de UI",
    hours: 6,
    date: "2024-11-15",
    status: "pending",
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
    memberName: "Carlos López",
    task: "Code Review",
    hours: 4,
    date: "2024-11-14",
    status: "approved",
  },
];

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "approved":
      return "default";
    case "pending":
      return "secondary";
    case "rejected":
      return "destructive";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectTimeTrackingPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const totalHours = mockTimeTracking.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.hours, 0);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Clock className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.timeTracking.title", "Seguimiento de Tiempo")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("projects.timeTracking.newEntry", "Nueva Entrada")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.timeTracking.totalHours", "Total Horas")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{totalHours}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {t("projects.timeTracking.thisWeek", "esta semana")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.timeTracking.approved", "Aprobadas")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {mockTimeTracking.filter((e) => e.status === "approved").reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.hours, 0)}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {t("projects.timeTracking.hours", "horas")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-medium">
                {t("projects.timeTracking.pending", "Pendientes")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {mockTimeTracking.filter((e) => e.status === "pending").reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.hours, 0)}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {t("projects.timeTracking.hours", "horas")}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={t("projects.timeTracking.search", "Buscar entradas...")}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.filter", "Filtrar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {mockTimeTracking.map((entry) => (
            <Card
              key={entry.id}
              className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300"
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg mb-2">{entry.task}</CardTitle>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <User className="w-4 h-4" />
                        {entry.memberName}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
                        {new Date(entry.date).toLocaleDateString()}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Badge variant={getStatusColor(entry.status) as any}>
                      {t(`projects.timeTracking.status.${entry.status}`, entry.status)}
                    </Badge>
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold">{entry.hours}h</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{entry.projectName}</span>
                  <Link href={`/projects/time-tracking/${entry.id}`}>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm">
                      {t("common.details", "Detalles")}
                      <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                    </Button>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
