```typescriptreact
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                    <div
                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${category.percentage}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```
```typescript
}

        projects: {
          title: "RAG Projects",
          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",

You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
```
```typescript
}

        projects: {
          title: "RAG Projects",
          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",

          title: "Create RAG Model",
          content:
            "<h4>AI Model Configuration</h4><p>This page allows you to create and configure new AI models for your RAG projects. You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { Calculator, Plus, Search, Filter, ArrowRight, DollarSign } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

interface CostEstimator {
  id: number;
  projectName: string;
  estimatedCost: number;
  actualCost: number;
  variance: number;
  status: "draft" | "approved" | "rejected";
  createdBy: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

const mockCostEstimators: CostEstimator[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
    estimatedCost: 500000,
    actualCost: 325000,
    variance: -175000,
    status: "approved",
    createdBy: "Juan Pérez",
    createdAt: "2024-10-01T00:00:00Z",
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    projectName: "Proyecto Beta",
    estimatedCost: 750000,
    actualCost: 0,
    variance: 0,
    status: "draft",
    createdBy: "María García",
    createdAt: "2024-11-15T00:00:00Z",
  },
];

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "approved":
      return "default";
    case "draft":
      return "secondary";
    case "rejected":
      return "destructive";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectCostEstimatorPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Calculator className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.costEstimator.title", "Estimadores de Costos")}
            </h1>
          </div>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("projects.costEstimator.newEstimator", "Nuevo Estimador")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={t("projects.costEstimator.search", "Buscar estimadores...")}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.filter", "Filtrar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {mockCostEstimators.map((estimator) => (
            <Card
              key={estimator.id}
              className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300"
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg mb-2">{estimator.projectName}</CardTitle>
                    <Badge variant={getStatusColor(estimator.status) as any}>
                      {t(`projects.costEstimator.status.${estimator.status}`, estimator.status)}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                      <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
                      {t("projects.costEstimator.estimated", "Estimado")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium">${(estimator.estimatedCost / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                  </div>
                  {estimator.actualCost > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("projects.costEstimator.actual", "Real")}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-medium">${(estimator.actualCost / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                          {t("projects.costEstimator.variance", "Varianza")}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className={`font-medium ${
                            estimator.variance < 0 ? "text-green-500" : "text-red-500"
                          }`}
                        >
                          ${(estimator.variance / 1000).toLocaleString()}K
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  {t("projects.costEstimator.createdBy", "Creado por")}: {estimator.createdBy}
                </div>
                <Link href={`/projects/cost-estimator/${estimator.id}`}>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    {t("common.details", "Detalles")}
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                    </div>
```

```typescriptreact
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <TrendingUp className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />

                      className="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full"
                      style={{ width: `${trend.cpu}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                    <div
                      className="bg-green-500 h-2 rounded-full"

                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
import { TrendingUp, Plus, Search, Filter, ArrowRight, DollarSign } from "lucide-react";

interface ProjectROI {
  id: number;
  projectName: string;
  investment: number;
  return: number;
  roi: number;
  roiPercentage: number;
  period: string;
  status: "positive" | "negative" | "neutral";
}

const mockROIs: ProjectROI[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
    investment: 500000,
    return: 650000,
    roi: 150000,
    roiPercentage: 30,
    period: "2024",
    status: "positive",
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    projectName: "Proyecto Beta",
    investment: 750000,
    return: 900000,
    roi: 150000,
    roiPercentage: 20,
    period: "2024",
    status: "positive",
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    projectName: "Proyecto Gamma",
    investment: 300000,
    return: 420000,
    roi: 120000,
    roiPercentage: 40,
    period: "2024",
    status: "positive",
  },
];

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "positive":
      return "default";
    case "negative":
      return "destructive";
    case "neutral":
      return "secondary";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectROIPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <TrendingUp className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.roi.title", "ROI de Proyectos")}

          </div>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("projects.roi.newROI", "Nuevo ROI")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={t("projects.roi.search", "Buscar ROI...")}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.filter", "Filtrar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {mockROIs.map((roi) => (
            <Card
              key={roi.id}
              className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300"
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg mb-2">{roi.projectName}</CardTitle>
                    <Badge variant={getStatusColor(roi.status) as any}>
                      {roi.roiPercentage.toFixed(1)}% ROI
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                      <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
                      {t("projects.roi.investment", "Inversión")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium">${(roi.investment / 1000).toLocaleString()}K</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.roi.return", "Retorno")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-green-500">
                      ${(roi.return / 1000).toLocaleString()}K
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.roi.netROI", "ROI Neto")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-green-500">
                      ${(roi.roi / 1000).toLocaleString()}K
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.roi.period", "Período")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium">{roi.period}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                  <div
                    className="bg-green-500 h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(roi.roiPercentage, 100)}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
                <Link href={`/projects/roi/${roi.id}`}>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    {t("common.details", "Detalles")}
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
```

```typescriptreact
interface ProjectToken {
  id: number;
  tokenName: string;
  projectName: string;
  tokenType: string;
  status: "active" | "expired" | "revoked";
  createdAt: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  lastUsed?: string;
}

const mockTokens: ProjectToken[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    tokenName: "API Token Alpha",
    projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
    tokenType: "API",
    status: "active",
    createdAt: "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z",

    lastUsed: "2024-11-15T10:30:00Z",
  },
  {
    id: 2,

    tokenType: "Deployment",
    status: "active",
    createdAt: "2024-06-01T00:00:00Z",
    expiresAt: "2025-06-01T00:00:00Z",
    lastUsed: "2024-11-14T15:20:00Z",
  },
];

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "active":
      return "default";
    case "expired":
      return "destructive";
    case "revoked":
      return "secondary";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectTokensPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={t("projects.token.search", "Buscar tokens...")}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.filter", "Filtrar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {mockTokens.map((token) => (
            <Card

                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                  {token.lastUsed && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                      <span className="font-medium">

                <Link href={`/projects/token/${token.id}`}>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    {t("common.details", "Detalles")}
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
          </div>
          <Button>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("projects.version.newVersion", "Nueva Versión")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder={t("projects.version.search", "Buscar versiones...")}
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
            />
          </div>
          <Button variant="outline">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            {t("common.filter", "Filtrar")}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {mockVersions.map((version) => (
            <Card
              key={version.id}
              className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl hover:border-primary/50 transition-all duration-300"
            >
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex-1">
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg mb-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Tag className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                      v{version.version}
                    </CardTitle>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">{version.description}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Badge variant="secondary">{version.projectName}</Badge>
                      <Badge variant={getStatusColor(version.status) as any}>
                        {t(`projects.version.status.${version.status}`, version.status)}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.version.releaseDate", "Fecha de Lanzamiento")}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-medium">
                      {new Date(version.releaseDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2 block">
                      {t("projects.version.changes", "Cambios")}
                    </label>
                    <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {version.changes.map((change, index) => (
                        <li key={index}>{change}</li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Link href={`/projects/version/${version.id}`}>
                  <Button variant="outline" className="w-full">
                    {t("common.details", "Detalles")}
                    <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                  </Button>
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
                <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">

                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { Calendar, GanttChart } from "lucide-react";

interface TimelineTask {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  progress: number;
  dependencies: number[];
}

interface ProjectTimeline {
  projectName: string;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  tasks: TimelineTask[];
}

const mockTimeline: ProjectTimeline = {
  projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
  startDate: "2024-01-15",
  endDate: "2024-12-31",
  tasks: [
    {
      id: 1,
      name: "Fase de Planificación",
      startDate: "2024-01-15",
      endDate: "2024-02-28",
      progress: 100,
      dependencies: [],
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      name: "Desarrollo Backend",
      startDate: "2024-03-01",
      endDate: "2024-06-30",
      progress: 75,
      dependencies: [1],
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      name: "Desarrollo Frontend",
      startDate: "2024-04-01",
      endDate: "2024-07-31",
      progress: 60,
      dependencies: [1],
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      name: "Testing e Integración",
      startDate: "2024-08-01",
      endDate: "2024-10-31",
      progress: 30,
      dependencies: [2, 3],
    },
    {
      id: 5,
      name: "Despliegue",
      startDate: "2024-11-01",
      endDate: "2024-12-31",
      progress: 0,
      dependencies: [4],
    },
  ],
};

export default function ProjectTimelineGanttPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  const calculateDays = (start: string, end: string) => {
    const startDate = new Date(start);
    const endDate = new Date(end);
    return Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  };

  const projectDays = calculateDays(mockTimeline.startDate, mockTimeline.endDate);
  const today = new Date();
  const projectStart = new Date(mockTimeline.startDate);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="text-center space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <GanttChart className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
              {t("projects.timelineGantt.title", "Timeline Gantt")}
            </h1>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
              {mockTimeline.projectName}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {mockTimeline.tasks.map((task) => {
                const taskDays = calculateDays(task.startDate, task.endDate);
                const daysFromStart = calculateDays(mockTimeline.startDate, task.startDate);
                const leftPercent = (daysFromStart / projectDays) * 100;
                const widthPercent = (taskDays / projectDays) * 100;

                return (
                  <div key={task.id} className="space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="font-medium">{task.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {new Date(task.startDate).toLocaleDateString()} -{" "}
                          {new Date(task.endDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm font-medium">{task.progress}%</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative h-8 bg-muted rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="absolute h-full bg-primary/30 rounded-lg"
                        style={{ left: `${leftPercent}%`, width: `${widthPercent}%` }}
                      />
                      <div
                        className="absolute h-full bg-primary rounded-lg transition-all duration-500"
                        style={{
                          left: `${leftPercent}%`,
                          width: `${(widthPercent * task.progress) / 100}%`,
                        }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
interface ProjectArtifactDetail {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  projectName: string;
  version: string;
  size: number;
  description: string;
  downloadUrl: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

  id: 1,
  name: "Sistema de Gestión v1.0",

    if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + " B";

    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + " MB";
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">

            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
```

```typescriptreact
};

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "active":
      return "default";
    case "expired":
      return "destructive";
    case "suspended":
      return "secondary";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
```

```typescriptreact
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import DevelopmentBanner from "@/components/ui/development-banner";
import { ArrowLeft, Edit, FileText, Calendar, DollarSign, Download } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";

interface ProjectBillingDetailDetail {
  id: number;
  invoiceNumber: string;
  projectName: string;
  amount: number;
  tax: number;
  total: number;
  status: "draft" | "sent" | "paid" | "overdue";
  issueDate: string;
  dueDate: string;
  paidDate?: string;
  description: string;
  lineItems: Array<{ description: string; quantity: number; unitPrice: number; total: number }>;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

const mockBillingDetail: ProjectBillingDetailDetail = {
  id: 1,
  invoiceNumber: "INV-2024-001",
  projectName: "Proyecto Alpha",
  amount: 45000,
  tax: 9000,
  total: 54000,
  status: "paid",
  issueDate: "2024-11-01",
  dueDate: "2024-11-30",
  paidDate: "2024-11-15",
  description: "Factura por servicios de desarrollo",
  lineItems: [
    { description: "Desarrollo Backend", quantity: 40, unitPrice: 1000, total: 40000 },
    { description: "Desarrollo Frontend", quantity: 5, unitPrice: 1000, total: 5000 },
  ],
  createdAt: "2024-11-01T00:00:00Z",
  updatedAt: "2024-11-15T10:30:00Z",
};

const getStatusColor = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case "paid":
      return "default";
    case "sent":
      return "secondary";
    case "overdue":
      return "destructive";
    case "draft":
      return "outline";
    default:
      return "outline";
  }
};

export default function ProjectBillingDetailDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const id = searchParams.get("id") || "1";
  const billingDetail = mockBillingDetail;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10">
        <DevelopmentBanner className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link href="/projects/billing-detail">
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon">
                <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </Link>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-primary/70 bg-clip-text text-transparent flex items-center gap-3">
                <FileText className="w-8 h-8 text-primary" />
                {billingDetail.invoiceNumber}
              </h1>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Badge variant={getStatusColor(billingDetail.status) as any}>
              {t(`projects.billingDetailDetail.status.${billingDetail.status}`, billingDetail.status)}
            </Badge>
            <Button>
              <Edit className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {t("common.edit", "Editar")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.information", "Información de Factura")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.description", "Descripción")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-foreground">{billingDetail.description}</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.project", "Proyecto")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-foreground font-medium">{billingDetail.projectName}</p>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle>
                  {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.lineItems", "Líneas de Factura")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {billingDetail.lineItems.map((item, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                      <div className="flex-1">
                        <div className="font-medium">{item.description}</div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {item.quantity} x ${item.unitPrice.toLocaleString()}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-bold">${item.total.toLocaleString()}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-6">
            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.amounts", "Montos")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.subtotal", "Subtotal")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-medium">${billingDetail.amount.toLocaleString()}</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.tax", "Impuestos")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-lg font-medium">${billingDetail.tax.toLocaleString()}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="border-t pt-3">
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.total", "Total")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold">${billingDetail.total.toLocaleString()}</p>
                </div>
                <Button className="w-full">
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                  {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.download", "Descargar PDF")}
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
              <CardHeader>
                <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                  {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.dates", "Fechas")}
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.issueDate", "Fecha Emisión")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-sm text-foreground">
                    {new Date(billingDetail.issueDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.dueDate", "Fecha Vencimiento")}
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-sm text-foreground">
                    {new Date(billingDetail.dueDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </p>
                </div>
                {billingDetail.paidDate && (
                  <div>
                    <label className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                      {t("projects.billingDetailDetail.paidDate", "Fecha de Pago")}
                    </label>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground">
                      {new Date(billingDetail.paidDate).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
            "<h4>¿Qué son los Proyectos RAG?</h4><p>Los proyectos RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) son sistemas inteligentes que combinan la recuperación de información con la generación de texto.           content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",
        },
        createProject: {
          title: "Create RAG Project",
          content:
            "Create a new RAG project by configuring embedding, reranker, and LLM models, as well as chunking parameters and Leka server configuration.",
        },
        editProject: {
          title: "Edit RAG Project",
          content:
            "Edit your RAG project configuration, including models, chunking parameters, Leka server configuration, and monitor project statistics.",
        },
        models: {
          title: "RAG Models",
          content:
            "Manage available AI models for your RAG projects, including embedding, reranker, and LLM models from different providers.",
        },
        createModel: {
          title: "Create RAG Model",
          content:
            "<h4>AI Model Configuration</h4><p>This page allows you to create and configure new AI models for your RAG projects. You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",
        },
        editModel: {
          title: "Edit RAG Model",

            "Edit the configuration of an existing AI model, including performance parameters, cost, and endpoint configuration.",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```

```typescript
          content:
            "<h4>¿Qué son los Proyectos RAG?</h4><p>Los proyectos RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) son sistemas inteligentes que combinan la recuperación de información con la generación de texto. Te permiten crear chatbots y asistentes que pueden responder preguntas basándose en tus propios documentos y datos.</p><h4>¿Para qué sirven?</h4><ul><li><strong>Chatbots Especializados:</strong> Crea asistentes que conocen tu documentación específica</li><li><strong>Búsqueda Inteligente:</strong> Encuentra información relevante en grandes volúmenes de documentos</li><li><strong>Respuestas Contextualizadas:</strong> Genera respuestas precisas basadas en tu contenido</li><li><strong>Automatización de Soporte:</strong> Reduce la carga de trabajo del equipo de soporte</li><li><strong>Base de Conocimiento Interactiva:</strong> Convierte documentos estáticos en una experiencia conversacional</li></ul><h4>Gestión de Proyectos</h4><p>Desde esta página puedes:</p><ul><li>Crear nuevos proyectos RAG con configuraciones personalizadas</li><li>Editar modelos de IA (embedding, reranker, LLM) para cada proyecto</li><li>Monitorear el rendimiento y estadísticas de uso</li><li>Gestionar las fuentes de datos asignadas a cada proyecto</li><li>Configurar parámetros de chunking y procesamiento</li></ul>",

          content:
            "<h4>What are RAG Projects?</h4><p>RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) projects are intelligent systems that combine information retrieval with text generation. They allow you to create chatbots and assistants that can answer questions based on your own documents and data.</p><h4>What are they used for?</h4><ul><li><strong>Specialized Chatbots:</strong> Create assistants that know your specific documentation</li><li><strong>Intelligent Search:</strong> Find relevant information in large volumes of documents</li><li><strong>Contextualized Responses:</strong> Generate accurate responses based on your content</li><li><strong>Support Automation:</strong> Reduce the workload of your support team</li><li><strong>Interactive Knowledge Base:</strong> Convert static documents into a conversational experience</li></ul><h4>Project Management</h4><p>From this page you can:</p><ul><li>Create new RAG projects with custom configurations</li><li>Edit AI models (embedding, reranker, LLM) for each project</li><li>Monitor performance and usage statistics</li><li>Manage data sources assigned to each project</li><li>Configure chunking and processing parameters</li></ul>",
        },
        createProject: {
          title: "Create RAG Project",
          content:
            "Create a new RAG project by configuring embedding, reranker, and LLM models, as well as chunking parameters and Leka server configuration.",
        },
        editProject: {
          title: "Edit RAG Project",
          content:
            "Edit your RAG project configuration, including models, chunking parameters, Leka server configuration, and monitor project statistics.",
        },
        models: {
          title: "RAG Models",
          content:
            "Manage available AI models for your RAG projects, including embedding, reranker, and LLM models from different providers.",
        },
        createModel: {
          title: "Create RAG Model",
          content:
            "<h4>AI Model Configuration</h4><p>This page allows you to create and configure new AI models for your RAG projects. You can configure:</p><ul><li><strong>Basic Information:</strong> Name, type (Embedding, Reranker, LLM), provider and version</li><li><strong>Technical Configuration:</strong> Endpoint, API Key, cost per token, maximum tokens and context window</li><li><strong>Advanced Options:</strong> Local vs remote model, active/inactive status</li></ul><p><strong>Model Types:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Embedding:</strong> Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search</li><li><strong>Reranker:</strong> Improves the relevance of search results</li><li><strong>LLM:</strong> Generates responses based on retrieved context</li></ul><p>Once configured, you can test the model before saving it to ensure it works correctly.</p>",
        },
        editModel: {
          title: "Edit RAG Model",

            "Edit the configuration of an existing AI model, including performance parameters, cost, and endpoint configuration.",

// Hook para usar traducciones
export function useTranslation() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [language, setLanguageState] = useState<Language>("es");

  // Solo ejecutar en el cliente después de la hidratación
  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
    const savedLanguage =
      (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    setLanguageState(savedLanguage);
  }, []);

  const getLanguage = (): Language => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      return (localStorage.getItem("codeflowx-language") as Language) || "es";
    }
    return "es";
  };

  const setLanguage = (language: Language) => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem("codeflowx-language", language);
      setLanguageState(language);
      // Recargar la página para aplicar el idioma
      window.location.reload();
    }
  };

  const t = (
    key: string,
    fallback?: string,
    params?: Record<string, string>
  ): string => {
    // Durante SSR o antes de la hidratación, siempre usar español
    if (!mounted) {
      const keys = key.split(".");
      let translation = translations["es"];
      for (const k of keys) {
        translation = translation?.[k];
        if (!translation) break;
      }
      // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
      return typeof translation === "string" ? translation : fallback || key;
    }

    const currentLanguage = getLanguage();
    const keys = key.split(".");

    // Buscar en el idioma actual
    let translation = translations[currentLanguage];
    for (const k of keys) {
      translation = translation?.[k];
      if (!translation) break;
    }

    // Si no se encuentra, buscar en español como fallback
    let fallbackTranslation = translations["es"];
    for (const k of keys) {
      fallbackTranslation = fallbackTranslation?.[k];
      if (!fallbackTranslation) break;
    }

    // Asegurar que devolvemos una cadena
    let finalTranslation =
      translation || fallbackTranslation || fallback || key;

    // Si finalTranslation no es una cadena, usar el fallback o la clave
    if (typeof finalTranslation !== "string") {
      finalTranslation = fallback || key;
    }

    // Reemplazar parámetros si existen
    if (params) {
      return finalTranslation.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, param) => {
        return params[param] || match;
      });
    }

    return finalTranslation;
  };

  return {
    language: mounted ? language : "es",
    setLanguage,
    t,
    mounted,
    availableLanguages: ["es", "en"],
  };
}
```
